description: React component for a note editing application's menu bar, including actions like preview, favorite, delete, download, copy UUID, sync, theme toggle, and settings.

methods.name: favoriteNoteHandler
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of the active note.

methods.name: trashNoteHandler
methods.description: Moves the active note to trash.

methods.name: syncNotesHandler
methods.description: Triggers synchronization of notes and categories.

methods.name: toggleDarkThemeHandler
methods.description: Toggles between dark and light themes.

methods.name: togglePreviewHandler
methods.description: Toggles between preview and edit modes.
